snippet.title: Deadwire - Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Inspired by classics like Hotline Miami, DeadWire delivers intense, fast-paced action fused with innovative hacking mechanics. A top-down tactical shooter with a hacking twist.
